lean.statement:
∀ {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
    [CompleteSpace E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
    (μ : Measure E) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (C : ℝ) (_hC : 0 < C),
    (∀ v : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ v → HasCompactSupport v →
      (∫ x, (v x)^2 * Real.log ((v x)^2) ∂μ) -
        (∫ x, (v x)^2 ∂μ) * Real.log (∫ x, (v x)^2 ∂μ) ≤
      2 * C * ∫ x, ‖gradient v x‖^2 ∂μ) →
    ∀ g : E → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ∞ g → HasCompactSupport g →
      (∫ x, (g x - ∫ y, g y ∂μ)^2 ∂μ) ≤
        C * ∫ x, ‖gradient g x‖^2 ∂μ
approved_definition_context: The carrier is a complete real inner-product normed group with its Borel measurable structure. FiniteDimensional refers to real linear dimension.
ContDiff real infinity means infinitely often continuously differentiable, not analyticity. HasCompactSupport means compact closure of the set where the function is nonzero.
IsProbabilityMeasure means total mass one. All integrals in the display are real Bochner integrals with respect to the displayed measure; gradient is the Riesz gradient of the given function.
Real.log is totalized with log 0=0; the product q*log(q) at zero is zero.
